notes.title: Demo update 0.4.3
notes.notes:
Added:

[list]
[*] All mobs can now become super elites. They will have additional skill and yellow outline
[*] All elites and super elites now have UI with hp, poison, bleed and aura effect
[*] Explosion effects
[*] Added 2 new bonus objectives
[/list]

Changed:

[list]
[*] Support skill now work differently - after you use them they will go to the side of the screen and start following cards they can support
[*] Multiple balance changes and bug fixes
[/list]

Added cards:

[list]
[*] Shady deal - [burn] draw 1 more card. gain one less mana. (on upgrade dont lose mana gain)
[*] Durable Weapons - [burn] all ranged weapons gain 1 durability. (on upgrade also gain 5 rotation hits)
[*] Mimi Weapon - mimics last melee weapon used (on discard also use this card)
[*] One for All - discard all cards and throw a ranged (based on last ranged weapon used) weapon every 1 second for 10 seconds
[/list]
